replay_source:
"""Hosted-only #785 audit. Usage: python -B audit-785.py NEW OLD OUTPUT.json."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

new, old, output = map(lambda x: Path(x).resolve(), sys.argv[1:])
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('PYSTACHY_') and k not in ('PYTHONPATH', 'PYTHONHOME')}
env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', LC_ALL='C', PYSTACHY_JOBS='2', PYSTACHY_IRCHECK='1')

def snapshot(root):
    def git(*args):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], text=True).strip()
    return dict(sha=git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), tree=git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
                tracked_and_untracked=git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'),
                ignored=git('ls-files', '--others', '--ignored', '--exclude-standard'))

data = dict(status='partial-hosted-only', python=sys.version, executable=sys.executable,
            environment_overrides={k: env[k] for k in ('PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE', 'LC_ALL', 'PYSTACHY_JOBS', 'PYSTACHY_IRCHECK')},
            before={str(r): snapshot(r) for r in (new, old)}, records=[], scaling=[], probes=[])
assert all(not s['tracked_and_untracked'] and not s['ignored'] for s in data['before'].values())

def save():
    data['replay_source'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
    output.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(cmd, root=new, extra=None, ir=False):
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, env=env | (extra or {}), capture_output=True, timeout=240)
        row = dict(command=cmd, cwd=str(root), extra_environment=extra or {}, exit=p.returncode,
                   seconds_advisory=time.monotonic()-start, stderr=p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
        if ir:
            row.update(stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(), ir_lines=len(p.stdout.splitlines()),
                       switches=p.stdout.count(b'  switch i64 '))
        else:
            row['stdout'] = p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        row = dict(command=cmd, cwd=str(root), timeout=240)
        p = None
    data['records'].append(row)
    save()
    return p, row

for pattern in ('test_typed*.py', 'test_*verif*.py'):
    p, row = run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tools', '-p', pattern, '-v'])
    print(pattern, row.get('exit'), flush=True)

selected = sorted(p for p in (new/'tests/programs/classes').glob('*inheritance*.py'))
selected += sorted(p for p in (new/'tests/programs/exceptions').glob('exc_*.py') if any(x in p.stem for x in ('compare', 'eq_')))
selected += sorted(p for p in (new/'tests/programs/inference').glob('dynany_subclass_*.py'))
for path in selected:
    rel = str(path.relative_to(new))
    sidecar = path.with_suffix('.path')
    extra = {'PYSTACHY_PATH': sidecar.read_text().strip()} if sidecar.exists() else {}
    current, cr = run([sys.executable, '-B', 'pystachy.py', 'ir', rel], extra=extra, ir=True)
    previous, pr = run([sys.executable, '-B', 'pystachy.py', 'ir', str(path)], root=old,
                       extra={'PYSTACHY_PATH': str(new/'tests')} if sidecar.exists() else {}, ir=True)
    data['probes'].append(dict(path=rel, source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                               current_exit=cr.get('exit'), previous_exit=pr.get('exit'),
                               current_lines=cr.get('ir_lines'), previous_lines=pr.get('ir_lines')))
    if path.stem in ('inheritance_compare_pairs', 'inheritance_comparisons', 'inheritance_container_compare_base',
                      'dataclass_inheritance_compare', 'exc_compare_base', 'exc_eq_subclass',
                      'dynany_subclass_cmp', 'dynany_subclass_eq'):
        p, row = run([sys.executable, '-B', rel, 'a1', 'a2'], extra={'PYTHONPATH': sidecar.read_text().strip()} if sidecar.exists() else {})
        if p is not None:
            expected = path.with_suffix('.out').read_bytes()
            err = path.with_suffix('.err')
            row['matches_recording'] = p.stdout + f'[exit {p.returncode}]\n'.encode() == expected
            row['matches_error'] = (p.stderr.decode().splitlines()[-1:] == err.read_text().splitlines()) if err.exists() else not p.stderr
            row['reference_version_caveat'] = 'CPython 3.12.14, not pinned 3.13.16; checked-in recordings not modified'
    save()
print('positive hosted probes', len(selected), flush=True)

errors = sorted(str(p.relative_to(new)) for p in (new/'tests/errors').glob('*/*.py')
                if any(x in p.stem for x in ('inheritance', 'exc_compare', 'exc_eq_', 'exc_record_eq')))
p, row = run(['sh', 'tests/run.sh', f'{sys.executable} -B -m pystachy', 'jit aot', *errors])
data['rejection_paths'] = errors
print('rejections', len(errors), row.get('exit'), flush=True)

sys.path.insert(0, str(new))
generate = runpy.run_path(str(new/'tools/inheritprobe.py'))['compare_source']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='audit-785-scaling-') as temp:
    for exc in (True, False):
        for n in (40, 80):
            source = generate(n, exc)
            path = Path(temp)/f'compare_{exc}_{n}.py'
            path.write_text(source)
            item = dict(exception=exc, subclasses=n, sites=8, source=source,
                        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest())
            for label, root in (('old', old), ('new', new)):
                p, row = run([sys.executable, '-B', 'pystachy.py', 'ir', str(path)], root=root, ir=True)
                item[label] = row
            data['scaling'].append(item)
            save()
            print('scaling', exc, n, item['old'].get('ir_lines'), item['new'].get('ir_lines'), flush=True)
data['after'] = {str(r): snapshot(r) for r in (new, old)}
save()
